title: 3 Things That Trip Up Groups Before the Bike Bar
why: Fact-led prep for warm leads who already picked a date: ID, meeting point, and the seated rule, so nobody gets left at the curb.
hook_options: Three things that leave groups standing at the curb.
Read this before your group books the bike bar.
The ride is easy. Getting on it is where groups mess up.
caption: The ride is the easy part. The three things that actually trip groups up: a real ID for everyone (it's 21 and up), the right meeting point (it depends on your tour), and staying seated while you're rolling. Save this and drop it in the group chat before anyone books an Uber. #neworleans #nolabachelorette #thingstodoinneworleans #nola

slides.headline: The ride is easy. Getting on is where groups slip.
Somebody forgot a real ID
slides.body: Every rider is 21 and up. Everyone. Including the friend who swears she looks 30.

slides.headline: Physical ID in every pocket
slides.body: Sort it at the hotel, not the curb. No ID, no ride. No exceptions for the birthday girl.

slides.headline: Going to last year's meeting spot
slides.body: Different tours start in different places. Your memory is not your confirmation email.

slides.headline: Read the email. Then call a rideshare.
slides.body: The Irish Channel tour meets at Port Orleans Brewing on Tchoupitoulas. Check yours before you leave.

slides.headline: Standing up to dance mid-street
slides.body: It's an open vehicle in real traffic. Your captain will ask you to sit. Every time.

slides.headline: Dance at the stops
slides.body: Seated while rolling, hands inside the rails. Need a bathroom? Shout STOP and the captain pulls over.

slides.headline: Real ID. Right address. Seated while rolling.
slides.body: Do those three and the only thing left is picking the first song.

slides.headline: Then it's just your group and the street
slides.body: Drink in hand, music up, a captain who knows which corners are alive.

slides.kicker: Save this. Send it to the planner.
slides.headline: Book the right tour the first time
slides.body: Mid-City or Irish Channel. Details and dates at nolabikebar.com.
